meta_title: Arb Life | Tree Surgery & Arborist Birmingham
meta_description: Arb Life provides professional tree surgery, crown reduction, and stump removal across Birmingham. Fully qualified arborists. Free quotes available.
hero_eyebrow: Qualified Arborists — Safe & Insured Tree Work
hero_subhead: Overgrown trees damaging your property? We safely fell, prune, and remove trees across Birmingham with full insurance and certification.
services_heading: Tree Surgery & Removal Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: From routine pruning to emergency storm damage clearance, we handle every aspect of safe, professional tree work.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: We safely fell trees of any size, including those near buildings and boundaries. Stumps are ground out or removed completely, leaving your garden clear and ready to use.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Shaping
services.desc: Reduce overgrown canopies to let light into your home and garden. We shape trees to enhance their health and appearance whilst maintaining structural integrity.

services.title: Deadwood Removal
services.desc: Dead and dying branches are a safety hazard. We remove them promptly to prevent damage and reduce disease risk to the rest of the tree.

services.title: Emergency Storm Damage
services.desc: Storm-felled or damaged trees blocking your drive or threatening your home? We respond quickly to clear debris and make the area safe.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Maintenance
services.desc: Keep boundaries neat and healthy. Our hedge cutting keeps growth in check and encourages dense, attractive foliage year-round.

services.title: Stump Grinding & Removal
services.desc: Dangerous and unsightly stumps removed completely. Grinding takes them below ground level so you can replant, pave, or build without obstruction.

about_pullquote: We fell and prune safely because your family's safety matters more than rushing the job.
about_para_1: Arb Life was established in Birmingham to bring professional, honest tree surgery to homeowners and businesses tired of overpriced or unsafe work. Over 18 years, we've built a reputation for thorough site surveys, transparent pricing, and meticulous attention to safety and environmental responsibility. Every member of the team holds relevant qualifications and insurance.
about_para_2: We're not the cheapest, but we're reliable. Customers come back because we finish on time, tidy up thoroughly, and explain what we're doing every step of the way. Whether you need routine crown lifting or emergency storm clearance, you get the same careful, professional approach.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Arb Life

reviews.text: Had a massive oak that was leaning towards the house after the winter storms. Got a call to Arb Life on the Wednesday, they came out Friday morning and had it down and the stumps ground out by lunchtime. Tidy, professional, and fair price. Would use them again in a heartbeat.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Our laurel hedge had completely taken over the back garden. Shane and the lads were round, trimmed it all back, stacked the cuttings for the tip, and left everything swept up. They were efficient and friendly. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Dead ash tree was overhanging next door's fence and we were worried about liability. Arb Life quoted reasonable, turned up on time, felled it safely with a crane, and even helped us work out what to plant in its place. Top service.
reviews.author: Robert G.
